caption: A metal paper clip is bent open and let go, and it stays in its new shape.

sa.check: A metal paper clip is held.
It stays in its new shape.
The bend comes first, then the release, then the shape holds.

pc.expect: The wire bends smoothly only where it is worked, without snapping.
pc.fail: The clip snaps in two; or it bends everywhere at once; or it stretches longer.

pc.expect: After release it keeps the bent shape and does not spring closed.
pc.fail: It springs back to its original shape; or it goes on bending after release; or it is already open before the fingers work it.

pc.expect: The clip moves only in the fingers.
pc.fail: It bends with no fingers on it; or it flies off; or it twists on its own after release.

pc.expect: Released, it lies or hangs where it is put.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or drifts.
The clip vanishes or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or it merges with the fingers.

pc.expect: The clip's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The clip changes colour; or the hands change; or the background rearranges.
